Warm water, low light, and skilled hands. Every visit at Claire’s Spa is built around one thing: you walking out lighter than you came in.

01 · Arrive
Before your treatment

Arrive early. Let the water start.

Come 20 minutes ahead and settle into the hydrotherapy lounge. The whirlpool loosens tight shoulders and lower backs so your therapist can work deeper with less effort.

Robes, towels and chilled water are waiting.

The treatment room

Stone, wood and green, nothing else.

Our rooms are quiet on purpose. A heated table, soft lighting and living plants keep your attention where it belongs: on your breath and your body.

Tell your therapist about any sore spots, injuries or pressure preferences before you begin.

The work

Warm oil, steady hands.

Every massage starts with warmed oil and long, slow strokes to read where you hold tension. From there your therapist adjusts pressure and technique to what your muscles need that day.

You can ask for more or less pressure at any point.

For two

The couples suite.

Two tables, two therapists, side by side, with a private steam soaking tub to share before or after. Made for anniversaries, birthdays, and friends who need the same afternoon off.

After

Take your time leaving.

Stay in the lounge with tea and water as long as you like. Drink plenty for the rest of the day, and go easy on hard workouts after deep work.

Ask about the oils used in your session if you’d like them for home.

The menu

Massages

All sessions are available in 60 or 90 minutes. Pressure ratings are a starting point; your therapist adjusts to you.

  • Swedish

    Long, flowing strokes and gentle kneading to calm the nervous system and improve circulation. The right place to start if you’re new to massage. Pressure

    60 / 90 min

  • Deep Tissue

    Slow, focused pressure into the deeper layers of muscle to release chronic knots in the neck, shoulders and back. Expect some intensity and a lot of relief. Pressure

    60 / 90 min

  • Hot Stone

    Smooth heated basalt stones placed along the spine and used as an extension of the therapist’s hands. The heat lets muscles release without heavy pressure. Pressure

    75 / 90 min

  • Hydrotherapy & Massage

    Thirty minutes in the whirlpool lounge followed by a full-body massage. Warm water first means tight muscles are already halfway there. Pressure

    90 / 120 min

  • Couples

    Any massage on this menu, side by side in the couples suite, with private use of the steam soaking tub. Pressure each your own

    60 / 90 min
